entries.name: flowplane.area
entries.description: Get the area of a flow plane.

entries.name: flowplane.contact
entries.description: Get the face-to-face contact at a given flow plane.

entries.name: flowplane.extra
entries.description: Get/set the data stored in the extra variable at index i for a flowplane. The value in an extra variable can by any valid FISH type.

entries.name: flowplane.find
entries.description: Get the flow plane for a given ID.

entries.name: flowplane.fromindex
entries.description: Get the flow plane for a given index (offset).

entries.name: flowplane.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to flowplane fpp in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: flowplane.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the flowplane in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: flowplane.head
entries.description: Get the first flow plane on the flow plane list.

entries.name: flowplane.hidden
entries.description: Get/set the hidden flag of the flow plane.

entries.name: flowplane.id
entries.description: Get the flowplane ID number.

entries.name: flowplane.index
entries.description: Get the index (offset) of the given flow plane. This can be used with the xmem, imem and fmem functions.

entries.name: flowplane.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the flowplane and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: flowplane.list
entries.description: Get the list of all flowplanes in the model. This is primarily used in the c loop foreach statement.

entries.name: flowplane.local1
entries.description: Get the first local coordinate axes in global system.

entries.name: flowplane.local1.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the first local coordinate axes in global system.

entries.name: flowplane.local1.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the first local coordinate axes in global system.

entries.name: flowplane.local1.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the first local coordinate axes in global system.

entries.name: flowplane.local2
entries.description: Get the second local coordinate axes in global system.

entries.name: flowplane.local2.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the second local coordinate axes in global system.

entries.name: flowplane.local2.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the second local coordinate axes in global system.

entries.name: flowplane.local2.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the second local coordinate axes in global system.

entries.name: flowplane.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum ID number assigned to any flow plane in the model. The next flow plane created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: flowplane.next
entries.description: Get the next flow plane on the flow plane list.

entries.name: flowplane.num
entries.description: Get the total number of flow planes in the model.

entries.name: flowplane.pos
entries.description: Get the position of a flow plane.

entries.name: flowplane.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the position of a flow plane.

entries.name: flowplane.pos.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the position of a flow plane.

entries.name: flowplane.pos.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the position of a flow plane.

entries.name: flowplane.prop
entries.description: Get/set a flow plane property. The string s is the name of the property to be assigned or retrieved. Possible values for s are:

entries.name: flowplane.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. It can be used with type.pointer.id to tell flow plane pointers from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.aperture.hydraulic
entries.description: Get the hydraulic aperture limited by specified maximum (flowplane property aperture-maximum)

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.aperture.mech
entries.description: Get/set the mechanical aperture.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.area
entries.description: Get the lumped area to the vertex.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.extra
entries.description: Get/set the data stored in the extra variable at index i for a flowplane vertex. The value in an extra variable can by any valid FISH type.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.ffactor
entries.description: Get/set the flow factor (ffactor) of the flow plane vertex.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.find
entries.description: Get a flow plane from a given ID.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.flowplane
entries.description: Get the flowplane associated with a given flow plane vertex.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.fromindex
entries.description: Get a flow plane from a given index (offset).

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to flowplane vertex fpvp in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the flowplane vertex in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.id
entries.description: Get the flowplane vertex ID number.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.index
entries.description: Get the index (offset) of the flow plane vertex. This can be used with the fmem, xmem and imem functions.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the flowplane vertex and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.knot
entries.description: Get the flow knot associated with a given flow plane vertex.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.list
entries.description: Get the list of all flowplane vertices in the model. This is primarily used in the c loop foreach statement.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.local1
entries.description: Get the local x-coordinate of a flow plane vertex.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.local2
entries.description: Get the local y-coordinate of a flow plane vertex.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum ID number assigned to any flow plane vertex in the model. The next flow plane vertex created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.next
entries.description: Get the next flow plane vertex from the flow plane vertex list.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.num
entries.description: Get the total number of flow plane vertices in the model.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.pos
entries.description: Get the position of a flow plane vertex.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the position of a flow plane vertex.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.pos.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the position of a flow plane vertex.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.pos.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the position of a flow plane vertex.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.property
entries.description: Get/set property for a flowplane vertex. The string s is the name of the property to be assigned or retrieved. Possible values for s are:

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.proppant.mconc
entries.description: Get the mass concentration of proppant of a flow plane vertex.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.proppant.thick
entries.description: Get the proppant thickness of a flow plane vertex (volume concentration times aperture).

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.proppant.vconc
entries.description: Get the proppant volume concentration.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.subcontact1
entries.description: Get one of the sub-contacts of face-to-face contact used for interpolation.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.subcontact2
entries.description: Get one of the sub-contacts of face-to-face contact used for interpolation.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. It can be used with type.pointer.id to tell flow plane vertex pointers from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.visc
entries.description: Get the viscosity of fluid at the vertex (viscosity will increase from the global value if the proppant concentration is greater than 0).

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.weight1
entries.description: Get the interpolation weight associated with subcontact 1 for a flow plane vertex.

entries.name: flowplane.vertex.weight2
entries.description: Get the interpolation weight associated with subcontact 2 for a flow plane vertex.

entries.name: flowplane.vertexlist
entries.description: Get the flow plane vertex list for a given flow plane.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.area
entries.description: Get the area of the flow plane zone.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.cracked
entries.description: Return true if the flow plane zone is flagged as cracked.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.discharge
entries.description: Get the discharge (units of length2/time)

entries.name: flowplane.zone.discharge.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the discharge (units of length2/time).

entries.name: flowplane.zone.discharge.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the discharge (units of length2/time).

entries.name: flowplane.zone.discharge.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the discharge (units of length2/time).

entries.name: flowplane.zone.extra
entries.description: Get/set the data stored in the extra variable at index i for a flowplane zone. The value in an extra variable can by any valid FISH type.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.find
entries.description: Get flow plane zone from a given ID.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.flowplane
entries.description: Get the flow plane associated with a given flow plane zone.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.fromindex
entries.description: Get flow plane zone from a given index (offset).

entries.name: flowplane.zone.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to flowplane zone fpzp in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the flowplane zone in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.id
entries.description: Get the flowplane zone ID number.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.index
entries.description: Get the index (offset) of a given flow plane zone. This can be used with the fmem, xmem and imem functions.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the flowplane zone and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.list
entries.description: Get the list of all flowplane zones in the model. This is primarily used in the c loop foreach statement.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum ID number assigned to any flow plane zone in the model. The next flow plane zone created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.next
entries.description: Get the next zone in the flow plane zone list

entries.name: flowplane.zone.num
entries.description: Get the total number of flow plane zones in the model.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.pos
entries.description: Get the position of a flow plane zone.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the position of a flow plane zone.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.pos.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the position of a flow plane zone.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.pos.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the position of a flow plane zone.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. It can be used with type.pointer.id to tell flow plane zone pointers from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.velocity
entries.description: Get the flow velocity. This is the discharge divided by the average zone aperture. Units are length/time.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.velocity.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the flow velocity. This is the discharge divided by the average zone aperture. Units are length/time.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.velocity.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the flow velocity. This is the discharge divided by the average zone aperture. Units are length/time.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.velocity.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the flow velocity. This is the discharge divided by the average zone aperture. Units are length/time.

entries.name: flowplane.zone.vertex
entries.description: Get a flow plane zone vertex. Input vertex number (1 - 3).

entries.name: flowplane.zonelist
entries.description: Get the flowplane zone list for a given flow plane.
